answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 75 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 10 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 75 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 980 bought sponsors, each risking real money. The violet of the design is public, the sonnet of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the vine of honest work is what finally pays.
